question: NVIDIA在2025年如何描述出口管制对中国Data Center业务的影响？

supporting_source.matched_phrase: Data Center revenue in China grew in fiscal year 2025

answer_summary: The repaired answer uses NVIDIA FY2025 10-K framing: export controls constrained China Data Center product mix and share, but NVIDIA offered compliant alternatives, ramped China-designed products that did not require export-control licenses, and China Data Center revenue grew in fiscal year 2025. Later H20/FY2026 disclosures are explicitly separated as later-period evidence.
